scope: Current APP-24 fonts fit complete clocks and hour-plus-seconds timers. Conservative normal intervals, not maximum representable sets; none is an explicit limitation, never a passing fit assertion. Bounds apply after conversion and presentation rounding. Other values retain APP-34 fallback. Not sensor validity or hardware qualification.
conditions: Full-screen dimensions; every native enlargement count, either alignment, Day/Night, worst applicable one-pixel halo. Regular role is absent from four-row/two-enlarged grids. Optional heading cardinal text may be omitted; required primary/secondary text may not.

fields.precision: 1 second below 10 hours; 1 minute at 10 hours and above under DVS-13
